title: ECHO: TOWARDS ADVANCED AUDIO COMPREHENSION VIA AUDIO-INTERLEAVED REASONING
reasoning: The paper focuses on advancing audio comprehension in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) through a new reasoning format. While it includes a mandatory 'Ethics Statement' discussing potential biases and safety risks associated with the training data and models used, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as part of its core research or methodology.
